info.title: OpenAsy Invoices
info.description: Invoices and credit notes with KDV and withholding, issued as e-Fatura or e-Arşiv through the GİB integrator invoices.yaml sets, with payments, reminders, recurring invoices, bank statements and exports for the accountant. Amounts are whole numbers of minor units (kuruş for TRY). Viewers read everything; editors change everything but erasures; admins also erase.

post.summary: A draft's totals, type, channel and next number, as issuing would write them
post.description:
The lines are read and rounded as a saved draft's are (each line once, half up; the totals are sums of the lines). Nothing is saved, and the number is only what issuing now would give. A line without a name yet is counted.

Needs the viewer role.

get.summary: An invoice with its payments and history

patch.summary: Change a draft, or an invoice the integrator refused
patch.description:
A sent invoice is never changed (409); a credit note corrects it. A refused one keeps its number, date and currency.

Needs the editor role.

delete.description:
An invoice with a number is kept, so no number is skipped.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Issue: e-Fatura or e-Arşiv, the next number, the UBL-TR XML, and on to the integrator
post.description:
Asks the integrator whether the buyer is an e-Fatura user, takes TCMB's rate for a foreign currency, gives the next number of the series and year, writes and checks the UBL-TR XML, and queues it to be sent. An invoice the integrator refused is issued again under its number with a new ETTN.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Import a bank statement and match it to invoices
post.description:
A line of money in pays the owed invoice whose number is in its text, or the one owed invoice of exactly that amount whose customer's name or tax number is in it. Lines seen before are not added again.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Delete a person on request, as Audience asks
post.description:
Waiting while one of their invoices is unpaid. Customers with no issued invoice are deleted; one with issued invoices loses their email and phone, and the invoices are kept for ten years (VUK 253, TTK 82).

Needs the admin role.
